title: rest action
description: Calls a REST endpoint, host/path, with the message, as the https action does, and replaces the body with the response.

host.title: Host
host.description: Base URL of the host, http(s)://host[:port]; by default the REST address of this dif

path.title: Path
path.description: Path on the host, such as echo/get/json

produces.title: Produces
produces.description: Content-Type of the request when the message sets none

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the response

throwExceptionOnFailure.title: Fail on error status
throwExceptionOnFailure.description: Fail the message when the response status is 400 or more
